Collect news from the Naver News Search API

Source: R/collect.R
collect_naver.Rd

Searches Naver News through the official Open API and returns the results in the standard news schema. The API returns headlines, a short summary (text), the publication time and links, but not full article bodies. source is the domain of the original article link.

Usage

collect_naver(
  query,
  n = 100,
  sort = c("date", "sim"),
  client_id = Sys.getenv("NAVER_CLIENT_ID"),
  client_secret = Sys.getenv("NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET")
)

Arguments

query

Search query.

n

Number of articles to collect (at most 1,000).

sort

"date" for newest first, "sim" for relevance.

client_id, client_secret

Naver Open API credentials.

Value

A tibble in the standard news schema with the extra columns query, originallink and link.

Details

Register an application at https://developers.naver.com/main/ to get a client id and secret, and store them as the environment variables NAVER_CLIENT_ID and NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET (e.g. in .Renviron) rather than in scripts. The API returns at most 1,000 results per query and allows 25,000 calls per day.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
news <- collect_naver("\uae30\uc900\uae08\ub9ac", n = 300)
tokenize_ko(news, field = "text")
} # }
